card.name: Month or day in historical dates
card.fires_on: Month names or day digits inside a full calendar date, right before the day or year is written. Seen in citations, history texts and news dates.

modes.label: Month name
modes.description: A month name or abbreviation that starts a date, followed by a day or year.

modes.label: Day digit
modes.description: The last digit of a two-digit day, just before the comma and year.
modes.example: The FTA was signed on January 1<<9>>, 2006, and

modes.label: Word before date
modes.description: A linking word such as on that comes right before a month and day.
modes.example: created during the French Revolution<< on>> March 4, 179

card.writes: It seems to push toward the next piece of a date, such as a day or year, and away from ordinal words like fifth or 第.
card.plain: It fires on months and day numbers inside written dates, as in citations and history text.
